purpose: Cube-and-conquer on the Erdos 273 hard-half-only instances. This lane is the box's SLACK ABSORBER: it takes every core no other queue is using, and every unit of work is one cube, so a kill costs one cube and never a run.

preflight.pass: prints `3/3 MATCH against receipted box metadata`
preflight.why: the box's --mode hardhalf was lost with the box; this proves the reconstruction emits the same vars/x_vars/clauses/literals as the three receipted exports
the 164 MB CNF is NOT in the repo; it is regenerated on the box in ~2.5 minutes
MANDATORY before any UNSAT aggregate is believed. Arm 2 checks the at-most-one constraint and the symmetry units against the real bytes; without it the aggregation rule is an assertion.

instances.role: the cheapest decisive certificate on the ladder
instances.drat: REQUIRED -- 439 KB instance, proofs are cheap and drat-trim can actually finish. An UNSAT here without a verified proof is a solver claim, not a certificate.

instances.role: the ceiling shot -- best reciprocal slack (S=2.2114, +10.57%) under the 2M-variable cap
instances.in_repo_reason: 164 MB artefact; the encoder is deterministic, so the bytes are regenerated rather than committed. The cube manifest IS committed -- it depends only on the pool, not on the CNF.
instances.drat: OPTIONAL -- at this size a DRAT proof runs to multiple GB per cube (the lost box reached 5.1 GB on N=27720 without a verdict). Enable only on a cube that has already returned UNSAT quickly, then re-run it with the proof on.

what_the_wrapper_does: SKIPS the cube if its checkpoint already holds SAT or UNSAT (idempotent restart)
assembles base CNF + cube units into $FILLER_TMPDIR (default /dev/shm) with a corrected `p cnf` header -- solver-agnostic, no assumption interface needed
runs the solver under a wall-clock cap
runs drat-trim IN PLACE, while the assembled file still exists, when a DRAT proof was requested and the result was UNSAT
writes the per-cube checkpoint, then unlinks the assembled file
command_template.tmpfs_budget: N=360360 assembles to ~164 MB per in-flight cube; 32 concurrent = ~5.3 GB of the box's 251 GB. Each is unlinked the moment its cube finishes.

parallel_launch.gnu_parallel: cut -d- -f2 cubes/N360360/index.txt | sed 's/\.cube//' | parallel -j 30 --nice 10 --joblog out/N360360/joblog.tsv bash run_cube.sh 360360 {} 3600 kissat
parallel_launch.xargs: python3 -c "import json;print('\n'.join(c['cube_id'] for c in json.load(open('cubes/N360360/manifest.json',encoding='utf-8'))['cubes']))" | xargs -P 30 -I{} nice -n 10 bash run_cube.sh 360360 {} 3600 kissat
parallel_launch.core_yielding: -j is the ONLY knob the box runner needs. Raise it when other queues drain, lower it when they refill. Cubes in flight when -j drops are killed and re-run from their checkpoint later; nothing is lost.

verdict_rules.SAT: solver exit 10. The cube's model is a model of the base instance (the split is a partition, so no restriction was lost).
verdict_rules.UNSAT: solver exit 20. With DRAT on, it is not a CERTIFICATE until `drat_verified` is true.
verdict_rules.TIMEOUT: any other exit after the cap. ESTABLISHES NOTHING. Not weak evidence of UNSAT.
verdict_rules.STOPPED_NO_VERDICT: exit 137/143 (SIGKILL/SIGTERM). A killed process is NOT a timeout and NOT a verdict. The campaign refiled four receipts over exactly this distinction on 2026-09-02; do not lose it again.

any_cube_SAT.meaning: a distinct-moduli covering of Z drawn from H n divisors(N) \ {2} exists.
any_cube_SAT.NOT: *** THIS IS NOT AN ERDOS 273 WITNESS. *** It is ONE HALF. Erdos 273 needs TWO DISJOINT halves.
then: 1. decode + independently verify: python3 decode_cube_model.py --layout cnf/hard-half-only-N<N>.layout.json --model out/N<N>/<cube>.solverlog --cube cubes/N<N>/cube-<cube>.cube --out out/N<N>/witness-<cube>.json
2. STAGE TWO -- find the complementary half (the one that may hold modulus 2) in pool minus the moduli this half used. decode_cube_model.py prints the exact command.
3. only if stage two closes AND the lifted object re-verifies is there a CANDIDATE witness, status WITNESS_UNVERIFIED
4. Lean kernel seal is what turns WITNESS_UNVERIFIED into a close. Route is fixed in SAT-LADDER-REPORT-2026-09-02.md; native_decide must be disclosed if used.

all_cubes_UNSAT.meaning: NO covering system of Z has distinct moduli all of the form p-1 (p prime >= 5) with lcm dividing 2N. A BOUND WITH AN EXPLICIT CEILING.
all_cubes_UNSAT.NOT: *** NEVER a refutation of Erdos 273. *** The problem quantifies over an infinite modulus pool; no finite N settles the negative branch.
all_cubes_UNSAT.precondition: partition_check.py must have returned PARTITION_PROVED with arm2_run true against the SAME CNF sha the manifest records.

anything_else.meaning: a partial sweep is NOT a partial bound. Establishes nothing about the rung.

kill_rules.stall: a cube with no checkpoint after secs_per_cube + 300 s is re-queued; the stall is logged
kill_rules.safe_to_kill: always -- checkpoints are written atomically per cube and finished cubes are skipped on restart

honesty.never_claim: OPEN -> closed on the negative branch
honesty.hard_half_is_half: every SAT in this lane is stage one of two, and the config says so in three places on purpose
honesty.no_receipt_for_3960_hardhalf_before_toda: the campaign holds hardhalf exports for N=27720/83160/360360 only. There is NO receipt in this campaign for a 600 s kissat run on a 3960 hard-half instance; that instance had never been built. It is built here for the first time.
